title: Replace repeated child-program admission seeks with linear record cursors
body:
The physical caller's actual `SelectedBinding.child_program` repeatedly seeks from the left through every earlier Program and raw-field record during Callback admission. This package derives its exact source-bound tape invoice and supplies a package-local monotone-cursor adapter that removes those repeated scans while preserving successful admission, returned bytes, numerical predicates, ownership and the original random-access Program after admission.

For history h, index/residue widths I/L and code width Q, let n=h+1, r=2I+L+5, c=Q+2I+90, F=Q+2+4096(L+1), and P=r+hc. The adapted complete producer uses Program `(5P+2hI+1,0,4P+8)` and Fields `(n(3F-Q-2)+3,0,2nF+4)` reads/writes/unit-moves. Returned-output construction and empty continuation checks are charged separately and unchanged. Original Fields work is quadratic in history. Complete record backing remains exactly `P+D+nF+14`, including LEFT, adjacent blanks and four empty continuation tapes; the adapter adds no tape or numerical word.

In the admitted h=6 fixture, complete record actions fall **4,633,704→1,166,975 (74.8155%)**, with identical returned bytes. Numerical actions separately fall 805,059→684,070; they are not treated as zero. The proof derives a conservative numerical action envelope from encoded loops and actual root/history coupling h<2(I−1), tightened to h<2(I−7) for successful extension. The claim is a tape/word-action ledger and candidate optimization, not a primitive finite-state realization or complete Pi/stock theorem.

Validation covers six original/adapted child-program pairs (good/pair/unit/half), three leaf-only pairs, exact record invoices, decoded chronology, residue counts, preserved bytes/heads, cleanup and visited backing. Seven malformed admissions and an altered-AST guard reject. Normal and optimized replay plus actual Git-free optimized positive, all 9 source-corruption controls and receipt mutation are registered.

An additional projected-definition pair uses exact current Q=6507 codes for rank-26 IDLE27776 and rank-7 COPY1603, verifies request/view tags and low hashes with canonical LowCodes, and executes actual child_program at modulus9 with nonzero high fields: 2048→832→91. The metadata projection came from the concurrent residual lane; source-plan/good-class reconstruction is an explicit fixture premise, not independently recertified here. This pair's Fields actions fall 518,355→297,839 with equal output bytes. No full GL64 payload, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, new κ, or independent human/formal review is claimed.

Same-session independent AI review authenticated all 9 source pins, examined cursor semantics/cost/root-history proof, checked mixed q3 history and leaf/random-access restoration, and reran the projected pair without blockers. The frozen baseline and candidate remain separately replayable. Shared and predecessor files are unchanged.

Canonical base 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90, priority revision 6. Explicit assigned scope refines selected-stock-envelope and PR3983's producer gap. Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3967#issuecomment-6263066320. Adjacent PR3999 concerns interruptions/abort; PR3995 pools IR; this package addresses normal unpooled source admission. Source history consists only of canonical inputs; the projected fixture is self-contained derived evidence.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's physical caller and SelectedBinding; David Arias/PR2753 and retained Nick Petalas/encoded controller/record/continuation lineage; PR3983; R437/OQ4 ai-nanachi/3647, zxv/3690, Ali Romman/1043, Sagar Thakrar/3700 and selected/native authors; immediate 3936/3950/3967. New work by Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex and same-session cross-agent assistance. Apache-2.0.

Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r437-source-preparation-bound`.

Next obligations: actual source/directory generation, child_extents/read_prefix, geometry/context and coefficient work, full lifetime role maxima, dispatch/slot/primitive tariffs, and admitted original-width stock. The new cursors are a research candidate awaiting shared-caller integration; unknown costs remain explicit.
